[[File:Pokémon the Comic cover.png|thumb|200px|Cover of Pokémon the Comic]]
(Japanese: '''ポケモン ザ コミック''' ''Pokémon the Comic'') is an official Pokémon comic mook—a comic book with the layout and design of a magazine—released in Japan on June 7, 2013.

==Content==
* A Pocket Monsters Special Dream Poster depicting [[Gym Leader]] and [[Pokémon Champion|Champion]] characters from the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga.
* A guide section with information about the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga's first 15 main characters.
* A {{wp|Paris}} & {{wp|Montreuil, Seine-Saint-Denis|Montreuil}} Book Fare section, chronicling [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]'s trip to {{wp|France}}.
* The first part of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] [[PSs1|Mt. Silver special chapter]], totaling 14 pages.
* Three different chapters of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}} of [[Pokémon Adventures]], including [[PS500]], [[PS501]], and the Gym battle between {{adv|Black}} and [[Drayden]], totaling 78 pages.
* A total of 66 pages of [[Pocket Monsters BW: Good Partners]], which is the finale of this manga (and the volume launched later).
* The second part of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] [[PSs2|Mt. Silver special chapter]], totaling 14 pages.

The [[Pokémon Adventures]] [[Mt. Silver]] special is the {{adv|Red}} and [[Pika]] chapter, which was announced during the 2011 Netkun popularity poll.
